protocol.application: Two separate CPU-2 windows, each PHP/baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline/PHP, fresh result cache each run, OS caches warm. No window pooling. Actual analysis timers; hardware counts cover the entire command. Five files and twenty findings, matching exit/stdout/stderr.
protocol.controls: All valid samples retained, five seeded shuffled pairs for long confirmation and deep controls. First short mixed-loop change prompted a five-pair 100-million-iteration confirmation, with one unmeasured warmup per binary. All raw measurements retained.
protocol.target_proof: Fixed inline representation allocates no overflow storage for offsets below 64; unit boundary test and eight direct PHP programs cover wide frames and long nested property chains. Allocation count for the whole application is not measured.
protocol.limits: 6 GiB aggregate, zero swap, exclusive lock, all processes inherit boundary. Native x86-64 only; no new JIT lowering or ABI.
